# temps_kv (Resource)

Turns on Temps' built-in key-value (Redis-compatible) service, which Temps runs as a container and offers to every project. Destroying the resource turns it off: Temps stops the container but keeps it and its data, so enabling the service again resumes it. Name its container with `temps_kv_settings` first if another Temps instance shares the Docker host.

Import with `kv`.

Required API key permissions: `kv:read`, `kv:write`, `kv:delete`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_kv_settings" "this" {
  container_name = "temps-kv-main"
}

resource "temps_kv" "this" {
  max_memory = "256mb"
  depends_on = [temps_kv_settings.this]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `docker_image` (String) Image to run; Temps picks its default when unset. Changing it upgrades in place.
- `max_memory` (String) Memory limit, for example `256mb`. Temps never returns it, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `persistence` (Boolean) Persist data to disk. Temps never returns it, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.

### Read-Only

- `healthy` (Boolean) Whether the service answers health checks.
- `id` (String) Import ID, `kv`.
- `version` (String) Version of the running service.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Singleton: the import ID is the resource type without the prefix.
terraform import temps_kv.this kv
```
